title: Throw
description: A generic throw (C4) in data/moves/<id>.json. The attacker plays its own grab clip; the defender plays the standard knockdown (E4), so there is never a paired animation. A throw cannot be blocked. The grab connects on the first active frame whose throwbox overlaps a throwable defender (grounded, not in hitstun, blockstun, knockdown or another throw); the defender then has break_window frames to press the throw buttons. Unbroken, the throw deals damage and knocks down for the fight-wide knockdown length (E4).

clip.description: The attacker's grab clip: data/clips/<clip>.json (F2). The defender never needs a matching clip (C4).

buttons.description: The two attack buttons pressed on the same tick that make the throw, and that the defender presses to break it. Same buttons in Kata and Kihon (K3).

recovery.description: Frames after the active window, on a whiff and after the throw lands.

break_window.description: Frames after the grab in which the defender's throw press breaks it (C4: 7).

pushback.description: Units the defender lands away on a completed throw, and each fighter slides on a break. Omitted values use the fight default (hit / block pushback).

throwboxes.description: Grab range per active-frame range, tested against the defender's stance body box. Each range must sit inside the active window.
